29814.q: - The PTIS, which was announced in Budget 2023 and will go live on 1 January 2024, will allow qualifying donors in Singapore to claim 100% tax deduction, capped at 40% of the donor's statutory income, for overseas donations made through qualifying local intermediaries. 1
29814.prev: - Two, to encourage giving overseas using Singapore family offices as a base, we will launch today the Philanthropy Tax Incentive Scheme (PTIS) for family offices.
